DECLARE @ITMREF VARCHAR(30)='#产品编码#'; DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(30)='#地点#'; DECLARE @REMINQTY DECIMAL(16, 2)='#需发数量#'; DECLARE @TAG VARCHAR(30)='{0}';
IF ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STOCK WHERE (ITMREF_0=@TAG OR SERNUM_0 = @TAG) AND ITMREF_0 = @ITMREF), 0) = 0 SELECT N'lang:{zh:扫描产品错误或无库存:,en:Scan product error or no stock:,de:Scan-Fehler oder kein Bestand:} ' + @TAG AS 数据检查 ELSE IF ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STOCK WHERE ITMREF_0=@TAG OR SERNUM_0 = @TAG), 0) > 1 SELECT N'lang:{zh:该产品存在于多个库位，请选择,en:Product exists in multiple locations, please select,de:Produkt in mehreren Lagerplätzen, bitte wählen}' AS 数据检查 ELSE SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN K.SERNUM_0<>' ' AND K.QTYSTU_0-ISNULL(XWS.QTY,0)-K.CUMALLQTY_0 >0 THEN 1 WHEN K.QTYSTU_0-ISNULL(XWS.QTY,0) -K.CUMALLQTY_0 > @REMINQTY AND K.SERNUM_0='' THEN @REMINQTY ELSE K.QTYSTU_0-ISNULL(XWS.QTY,0) -K.CUMALLQTY_0 END AS REAL) 发货数量 ,K.LOC_0 库位 ,K.SERNUM_0 序列号 ,CASE WHEN K.QTYSTU_0-ISNULL(XWS.QTY,0)=0 THEN N'lang:{zh:可用库存为0,en:Available stock is 0,de:Verfügbarer Bestand ist 0}' ELSE 'OK' END AS 数据检查 ,K.STOCOU_0 STOCOU FROM STOCK K LEFT JOIN (SELECT STOCOU_0 ,SUM(QTY_0) QTY FROM XWSSDH WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 GROUP BY STOCOU_0)XWS ON XWS.STOCOU_0 = K.STOCOU_0 WHERE K.STOFCY_0 = @FCY AND (K.ITMREF_0=@TAG OR K.SERNUM_0= @TAG)
